setup_boost: run setup-boost to clone the Boost superproject and bootstrap the build environment for the redis library
build_b2_distro: run build-b2-distro to build a Boost distribution using b2 install with a specified toolset
build_cmake_distro: run build-cmake-distro to build a Boost distribution using cmake with a specified generator and build type
run_b2_tests: run run-b2-tests to build and run the redis library tests using b2 with a specified variant and cxxstd
run_cmake_standalone_tests: run run-cmake-standalone-tests to execute the test suite built as a standalone cmake project
